About the book

Takeshi Young, a salsa dancer, instructor and founder of Salsa Vida, created Illustrated History of Salsa Dance. Each spread opens onto a different moment in salsa’s history. Tap an instrument, a musician or a pair of dancers to discover the story behind it.

Inspiration

The idea of telling this history through a pop-up book was inspired by The Folded Atlas by John Lindquist.

Make your own pop-up book

Use the Popup Book template on GitHub to tell a story of your own. The original code, writing and illustrations are available under CC BY 4.0.

If you adapt the book, here’s a credit you can use and tailor to your changes.
